title: Kormányablak és hatósági ügyintézés összefoglalása
grammar: Grand synthesis of public administration and civic procedures

sections.title: Consolidation Goals
items: I can follow and retell a short account of renewing an ID card and registering a new address.
I can understand sentences about applications, missing documents and appeals.
I can read a short text about a visit to the government window.
I can use the words for appointments, documents and online administration.
